notes.title: "Win a Key for a Friend" Event next weekend
notes.content:
When: 6pm EST 6/18/16 (UTC/GMT -4 hrs)

This will be our first event where we have something to give away. We will be giving away keys to Boss Monster so you can give them to your friends so you can play together. How the event will work is for a couple hours me and some friends will be in the world wide multiplayer lobby. All you have to do is play a game with me or one of them. The players that play with me in my first five games will all get a free Boss Monster key. The players that play with my friends will also get keys except you won’t know who they are so any game you play there will be a chance you could get a key.
	
**IMPORTANT** In-game use your user name as your name so it is easy to find you and give you your game key. Also in this event players are limited to only winning 1 game key.

-Enaz13

notes.title: Flash Event this Weekend
notes.content:
Join Us

We are having a Flash Event this weekend, for those that did not get the notice of the event please join Boss Monster's Game Hub so you will get future event announcements. And I also suggest joining our official community group to find players to play with.

Join Boss Monster's Game Hub here:
http://steamcommunity.com/games/362350

Join the Boss Monster Offical Community Group here:
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BossMonsterFriendlyFightClub

Let's Just Play (Flash Event) 8/28/16 9pm EST

We’re kicking off our first Flash Event! It’s going to be an old fashioned get-together. So join me this weekend in the online multiplayer. Let’s see how many players online we can get on at once.

notes.title: New Group and Events
notes.content:
Boss Monster’s Friendly Fight Club

We have officially started the Boss Monster group. It’ll be a place for people to more easily find other people to play with and a place to have questions answered about the game by other players. We may also give advanced notice of events there so please join. Just got to the link below and join up. 

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/BossMonsterFriendlyFightClub

  
Events Coming!!!

We are going to be starting events soon to help build the multiplayer community. They are going to be two types of events: 

Flash Events – Think of these like flash mobs. These events we will give short notice, maybe two to forty-Eight hour before, and mainly will be times you know you can get on and find other players to play with. These events may sometimes have things you could win but the main purpose of these events is just having fun playing Boss Monster with other players. 

Main Events – These will be the big events that may include developers or the creators of Boss Monsters. We will give advanced notice and they may be themed, have prizes, or a number of things. 

We are going to be announcing the events through Steam’s event scheduler so be sure to have your Steam settings set so you can see the messages when they pop up. I look forward to playing more with everyone, if anyone has any ideas for possible types of contests/prizes we can have at these events please feel free to share your ideas.


-Enaz13
